notes.title: Mega Update
notes.content:
[i]Hello there,
Today we released a mega update that fixes the bugs found in the game, makes extensive graphics improvements, new puzzles, and many other changes.[/i]


[h1]The changes included in this mega update;[/h1]

[b] [*] Unity 2020 Game Engine update
[*] Renewed language translations (EN-TR)
[*] Lighting improvements
[*] The quality of all shadows has been improved
[*] New objects
[*] New puzzles
[*] Optimization improvement
[*] New secret room (New year)
[*] New achievement (The Gift)
[*] New music added to all levels
[*] Button graphics in all sections have been changed
[*] Intro changed
[*] Restart button deleted from stop menu ('K' key function still works) [/b]
[/ list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Black screen error on opening screens has been fixed.
[*]Leaderboard menu animation bug fixed.
[*]Chapter 1 (Introduction to Story): Text animations have been improved.
[*]Episode 2 (The Experiments): Door Physics has been improved.
[*]Chapter 3 (Warehouse); The cube chart and physics in the last scene have been updated.
[*]Episode 4 (Thorns): Wall and floor physics of abandoned room updated, initial sound effect added, 
    unlimited teleport platform bugs fixed.
[*]Chapter 5 (Teleportation Center): Shadow bugs fixed, teleport crystals position changed.
[*]Chapter 6 (Station): Puzzle mechanics improved, background visuals changed.
[*]Chapter 7 (Energy Room): Fixed moving floor bug, new puzzle item added, wall their visuals have 
   been changed.
[*]Section 8 (Nuclear Wastes): Fixed dead bug in save point, hoistway puzzle mechanics were renewed, 
    needle printing machines park was simplified, nuclear waste pool track has been renewed.
[*]Episode 9 (Lobby): Elevator bug fixed, puzzle mechanics updated and new puzzle added.
[*]Chapter 10 (Robot Units): Laser corridor wall visuals changed, bugs moving crystals corrected.
[*]Final scene camera animation bug fixed.
[/list]


Have a good game!

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Hello,
Today we released an update that fixes some bugs in the game, makes graphic improvements and other changes.


The changes included in this update;

- Elevator errors are fixed.
- Needle Press Machine coating has been changed.
- The registration crystal error in Chapter 8 has been fixed.
- Lighting improvements were made.
-Main Menu background image has been changed.

Good Games!

notes.title: Cumulative Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35724426/2885284274f87fa299ef951e9a85cbdc5927585c.jpg[/img]

Hello, many bugs have been discovered since the release of the game. Today we release an update that corrects all of these errors.

Also some new puzzles have been added to the maps. Existing puzzles have been developed.

Some wall and floor coverings were changed.

New mini rooms have been added.

New objects have been added.

Optimization was improved.

Good Games!
